purpose: Exhaustive F5 cluster-to-current-AP-target worklist. A category describes what needs review; it does not authorize a gate or certify accessibility.
classification_basis: Native F5 collision coordinates, native-to-AP mapping, WiKirby prose/composites, and bounded native-source role checks. See the linked role review for evidence levels and unresolved route questions. Visible artwork alone is not the metal definition.
implementation_status: Only native557 Goal1 tomato (MASTER_HAND guarantees Smash) and native176 Goal2 drink (BATAFIRE guarantees Burning) have bounded conditional witnesses. Other source assignments and unaccepted routes remain unvalidated; starting-inventory removal remains blocked.

categories.ap_exit: A directed AP edge may need metal traversal; entry/source/geometry still require acceptance.
categories.ap_target: A specific AP item check may be protected; source and target identity still require acceptance.
categories.optional_non_ap_pickup: Article identifies loose loot not represented as a current AP check; this alone does not prove unrelated exits.
categories.bypass: Existing controller evidence reaches an AP exit without breaking any F5 in this room; optional loot is outside that proof.
categories.unknown: Cluster function or AP path relevance has not yet been established.
categories.scenery_no_required_passage: Role review finds no mandatory AP-check passage through this cluster. It may be a real breakable obstacle, optional transport or source side room; this does not prove any whole-room bypass.

cluster_identity: Room ID plus minimum x/y identifies a four-neighbor F5 component in docs/metal-tile-inventory.json. Coordinates are not duplicated; bounds and tile_count are verified against that inventory.

legacy_block_placeholder_audit.scope: All string-valued tokens in data/**/*.json; counts are occurrences, not proven metal barriers. Each current occurrence is a rooms.json directed exit condition.
legacy_block_placeholder_audit.semantics: CanBreakBlocks and its can_break_block alias are currently permissive, not permission or equipment tests. Many bindings describe ordinary Normal-breakable terrain. The eight-ability descriptive constant is not a source, movement, ammunition or complete move witness.
legacy_block_placeholder_audit.removal_requirement: Cross-check affected paths against actual native F5 geometry and AP targets. Do not turn all aliases into metal gates. Legacy metal and floating-block tokens are also permissive; their names do not establish accepted routes.
